title: Process Tool Settings
description: Define tool settings according to process definition heirarchy

tool_info.description: A list of available tool settings in this setup

data.description: A collection of available tools for different process type and section type

items.description: tool data. The first one in the list will be used as defaul tool for Scanning, GoTarget, etc.

filename.description: Name of the file (without extension) pointing toward /configs.

tcp_count.description: Number of tcps contained in the /configs/<filename>.yaml. To add more tcp, just make the tcpFile parameter into a list in the yaml file.

0.description: A list of available tool for sanding section (sectionType = 0)

7.description: A list of available tool for grind section (sectionType = 7)

15.description: A list of available tool for inspection section (sectionType = 15). An inspection section inherits the sanding process's tools and TCPs.

4.description: A list of available tool for spatter section (sectionType = 4)

5.description: A list of available tool for polish section (sectionType = 5)

items.description: Info for different tools. (A list of object)

tool_id.description: Tool index that matches the index of [tool_info]

tcp_id.description: Tcp index that matches the index of [tcpFile] under /tools/configs/[tool_info.filename].yaml
